source_material.summary: 2026年10月24日，傑克·多西旗下Block發佈全新語音模型Dessa。它完全基於人類語音數據訓練，支持本地部署，發音異常逼真，能模擬笑聲、停頓、哭泣等情感；作爲全雙工語音轉語音模型，可同時聆聽與對話，知識庫直接來自對話數據，無需依賴大型語言模型檢索，區別於以文本爲生成輸入的傳統語音模型。

sources.title: Nvidia開源Flora，使機器人影片標註成本比GPT-6 Astra便宜125倍 / Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra
sources.title_zh: Nvidia開源Flora，使機器人影片標註成本比GPT-6 Astra便宜125倍
sources.title_en: Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra
sources.title_original: Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra

source_material.title: Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra
source_material.summary: Nvidia's new data engine Flora labels one hour of robot video for 72 cents instead of $88 with GPT-6 Astra, while scoring slightly higher on quality. The open system, built on three fine-tuned Qwen3.5 models, catches errors in robot actions far more reliably than any competitor but sometimes falls short on descriptive accuracy. Nvidia is positioning Flora as a key piece of its strategy to control the entire robotics value chain. The article Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra appeared first on The Decoder .
